A breathtaking 15-second continuous one-take third-person chase camera sequence. Extreme speed, dynamic motion blur, and seamless transitions between all 6 backgrounds.

SHOT 1 (0-2.5s): Starts on <Picture 2> (floating immortal palace terrace above sea of clouds). The camera follows closely behind <Picture 1> as he accelerates forward riding his flying sword. He leans sharply into a turn, sparks flickering from the blade. He speeds straight toward the grand palace gate.
SHOT 2 (2.5-5s): Seamless transition into <Picture 3> (Heavenly Gate "Tiandao Gate", cloud-surrounded stone causeway). The camera glides through mist. <Picture 1> soars low over the stone pathway, wielding his ancient sword to leave a glowing pale gold trail. He leaps over stone balustrades, flying smoothly onward.
SHOT 3 (5-7.5s): He bursts forward, transitioning into <Picture 4> (giant vermilion arch gate of celestial palace). The camera tilts down to reveal the massive layered heavenly buildings and cascading waterfalls. He skims above the reflective marble plaza, mist billowing dramatically. He swings his sword to paint a glowing golden arc in the air, propelling himself forward.
SHOT 4 (7.5-10s): He dives along the grand palace avenue, entering <Picture 5> (grand palace hall corridor). The camera shakes violently with the speed. Golden carved beams and red pillars streak across the screen. He flies low along the long sacred pathway, dodging distant immortal figures, his black ink-wash robe billowing wildly in the celestial wind.
SHOT 5 (10-12.5s): He spins through a glowing golden magic ring, transitioning into <Picture 6> (giant red-and-gold heavenly arch). The camera slows down slightly for a split second (bullet-time effect) as swirling cloud mist drifts around him. He draws a massive glowing golden rune in the air with his sword, then speeds up again.
SHOT 6 (12.5-15s): He flies out of the cloud mist, arriving at <Picture 7> (ancient giant golden banyan tree palace above clouds). The camera pulls back slightly to show the epic scale of the sacred ancient tree palace. He strikes a final, triumphant pose, holding his sword high as he glides toward the glowing circular stone altar.
